draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and seed spread (exp1/cmp2). No noise-perturbation experiments, no F1-drop values (0.6/1.3/1.8), and no T2 table exist. The cited evidence IDs (T2.r1.th_drop etc.) are absent from the package.
